missions.name: 01  /  INITIATION
missions.description: A controlled assessment at the fictional Civic Evaluation Annex.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Your primary target is the moving assessment unit in the chamber. Disable it, complete the three record lessons, and leave through the marked exit. Each lesson earns one permanent coin. The two guards are part of the evaluation.
missions.debrief: Ruby: You kept your head. Blackline can use that. The next file is already on your desk.

missions.name: LEGACY  /  THE MERIDIAN
missions.description: Trace a missing archive through a luxury hotel.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Your primary target is Adrian Locke, the Meridian's operations director. Confront him or tag him for Blackline about the archive transfer. Ivo Chen is a records witness: question him and recover two records. The Covenant is interested too; we don't know why yet.
missions.debrief: Ruby: Locke's account, Chen's testimony and the records point beyond the hotel. The Covenant is not our employer, and I intend to learn who is paying them.

missions.name: 02  /  TUNG CHUNG
missions.description: Hong Kong operation — early playable campaign build.
missions.briefing: Ruby: A Covenant courier is moving a train manifest through Tung Chung. Confront the courier, retrieve the key from the courier and reach the platform exit.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The manifest points to a handoff in the streets. The train has not revealed who commissioned it.

missions.name: 03  /  THE STREETS
missions.description: Hong Kong operation — early playable campaign build.
missions.briefing: Ruby: A market intermediary arranged the transfer. Speak to the vendor for context, confront the intermediary, and recover the second key from their bodyguard. The nearby market lanes have a lookout and a service room.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The handoff leads to a commercial office. Keep the key separate from the manifest.

missions.name: 04  /  THE DISTRICT
missions.description: Hong Kong operation — early playable campaign build.
missions.briefing: Ruby: A district broker knows the office route. Speak to the records clerk, confront the broker and find the third key in the records safe. The commercial quarter has a lookout and an upper service room.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The broker points to a waterfront meeting. We still do not know who is behind the Covenant transfer.

missions.name: 05  /  THE HARBOUR
missions.description: Hong Kong operation — early playable campaign build.
missions.briefing: Ruby: A waterfront liaison is managing the transfer. Speak to the quay attendant, confront the liaison and recover the fourth key from their bodyguard. Explore the promenade and service room for alternatives.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The trail ends in the mountains. Do not confuse the public landmark with the operation.

missions.name: 06  /  NGONG PING
missions.description: Hong Kong operation — early playable campaign build.
missions.briefing: Ruby: The final coordinator is in the surrounding mountain district. Confront them and recover the fifth key from the field safe, away from the landmark.
missions.debrief: Ruby: All five keys are secure. The USB can be decrypted on the secure channel; the contents still need analysis.

equipment.name: Training sidearm
equipment.description: Unsuppressed fictional assessment pulse. Five charges. Aim with right mouse; fire with left mouse.

equipment.name: Quiet line
equipment.description: Temporarily disables one nearby person without graphic effects. Q uses it.
